prompt:
Our fintech platform is undergoing a compliance review next week, and the security team has flagged our microservices' dependencies as a risk. We have two services in the workspace: a Node.js API gateway (`api-gateway/`) and a Python risk-scoring engine (`risk-scorer/`). Before the review, I need a full dependency health assessment of both services.

Please audit all dependency manifests you can find, identify any security vulnerabilities, flag outdated packages (distinguishing between minor updates and breaking major-version changes), and detect any packages that are declared but never actually used in the source code.

Save your complete findings as a file named `dependency_health_report.md` in the workspace root. The report must be organized by priority so the engineering team knows exactly what to fix first and in what order, and it should include ready-to-run commands they can copy-paste to apply the fixes.
